# Updates hosted on public GitHub Releases

Anivora now checks the public `brandon-300/Anivora-Releases` feed and downloads signed APKs directly from GitHub's CDN. APK transfers no longer consume Render bandwidth. The application source remains private.

If your existing updater cannot connect to Render, [download the latest APK manually](https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora-Releases/releases/latest) and install it over Anivora. Do not uninstall. This one-time manual installation moves you to the public updater; later updates can run without Render. Users several Android version codes behind can install the latest directly.

The package ID, signing certificate and downloaded APK checksum/size checks are preserved. Downloads resume using HTTP Range when available; a host that ignores Range causes a safe full re-download followed by the same verification. GitHub feed failures show a retry message and are not reported as “up to date.”

This changes only app update distribution. Backend-dependent account, library and comment features still need Render to be available.
